lines.text: A Bahamas island costs about five million. That's the easy part.
Twelve acres in the Exumas. Two white-sand beaches. Your own harbor.
Add a house, and you need a live-in caretaker: forty-two grand a year.
Insurance in hurricane country: thirty-five thousand.
Salt air eats everything. Maintenance: fifty-five grand.
The boat is your only road. Fifteen thousand to run it.
Add solar, desalination and property tax: a hundred seventy-seven thousand a year.
That's almost five hundred dollars a day. Still want the island?
